decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's core star-tracker and camera heritage, and long space qualification and sales cycles make keeping an established product sensible.
The modular navigation camera line serves the growing small-satellite market and fits the firm's strategy of flexible, compact sensors.
Space situational awareness is a growing, publicly funded field that uses the firm's optical know-how, so the firm keeps the suite despite uncertain early demand.
The newly launched radiation-hard camera line is close to the core business, has its own page, and needs time to win missions.
The asteroid navigation camera is likely tied to specific agency missions and is only mentioned on the website, but it is too new and strategically valuable to drop.
